items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The next night, we contacted the head of – the mayor of Cincinnati at that time was a very light-skinned black person.

ctx.x: The next night, we contacted the head of – the mayor of Cincinnati at that time was a very light-skinned black person. He said he would do something about it. We contacted the head of the NAACP in Cincinnati. They were supposed to do something about it. Nobody did anything about it.
Why were they beating him? Why did they beat him up?
